description: Date-level (daily) campaign-group performance for specific campaigns over one period: per date + campaign group, impressions, clicks, currency-converted spend, orders, and currency-converted revenue. Grouped by date so each row is one campaign group on one day; also carries campaign group name/id, merchant name/id, os_client_id, campaign subtype, and campaign group status. Requires a campaign_id filter (the marketing campaign id) to scope to specific campaigns.

date.description: The calendar date (from campaign_performance_facts) the performance is bucketed on, enabling per-day grouping.

campaign_id.description: The marketing campaign id (campaign_tagging_data.marketing_campaign_id). MANDATORY per-call filter used to scope the report to specific campaigns.

merchant_name.description: The merchant (seller) that owns the campaign group.

merchant_id.description: The merchant (seller) id that owns the campaign group.

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id the campaign belongs to (marketing_campaign_dimensions.client_id).

campaign_subtype.description: Campaign group subtype (marketing_campaign_group_dimensions.campaign_subtype), e.g. OS_ADS_SEARCH, SMART_SHOPPING, AUCTION, BLOCK_BUY.

campaign_group_status.description: Effective status of the campaign group, underscores replaced with spaces (e.g. 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED').

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions for this campaign group on this date.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks for this campaign group on this date.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend for this campaign group on this date, converted to the marketplace currency.

orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions ELSE 0 END), 0)
orders.description: Program orders (per-click-timestamp conversions) attributed to this campaign group on this date.

revenue.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
revenue.description: Program revenue / GMV (per-click-timestamp sales) attributed to this campaign group on this date, converted to the marketplace currency.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_performance_facts` AS cpf JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON cpf.campaign_id = ctd.campaign_id AND cpf.client_id = ctd.client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd ON ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = mcd.client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions` AS mcgd ON mcd.marketing_campaign_group_id = mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id AND mcd.client_id = mcgd.client_id AND mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id = ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id AND mcgd.client_id = ctd.client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.monetize_merchant_dimensions` AS mmd ON mcgd.client_id = mmd.client_id AND mmd.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.agency_id = mmd.agency_id AND mc.marketplace_type = 'monetize' JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = cpf.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND mcgd.campaign_type IN ('PERFORMANCE', 'INVENTORY', 'OFFSITE') AND (mcgd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' OR mcgd.campaign_origin IS NULL) AND mmd.merchant_id NOT LIKE 'NULL' AND mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
